newsitem.title: CHINA: China issues $6.59 bln in non-tradeable bonds.
newsitem.headline: China issues $6.59 bln in non-tradeable bonds.

text.p: China has issued 54.727 billion yuan ($6.59 billion) worth of non-tradeable bonds this year, or 44.49 percent of the target for the whole year, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday, quoting central bank statistics.
In the first 10 days of April alone, China issued 13.042 billion worth of non-tradeable bonds, it said.

China has issued 16.698 billion yuan worth of two-year non-tradeable bonds this year, 29.887 billion yuan worth of three-year non-tradeable bonds and 8.142 billion yuan worth of five-year non-tradeable bonds, it said.
